slides.screen: Two browser address bars stacked: localhost:3000 (greyed, 'only on your laptop') and campus-bus.vercel.app (highlighted .focus)

slides.label: Pick a host
slides.idea: Pick the free host by what you built: HTML -> GitHub Pages; React/Next.js -> Vercel or Netlify; Node/Python backend -> Render.
slides.title: It's not about the most popular host.
slides.line: It's the free host that fits what you built.
slides.device: not A or B, it's C
slides.screen: Three browser tabs (GitHub Pages settings, Vercel New Project, Render New Web Service) with the Vercel 'Import Git Repository' list in front: aarav-codes/campus-bus with an Import button

slides.label: The clicks
slides.idea: Import your repo, add secret keys under Environment Variables, click Deploy. Never push .env.
slides.title: Import your repo on Vercel and click Deploy.
slides.line: Keep your .env file out of GitHub.
slides.screen: Vercel 'Configure Project' cropped: Framework Preset Next.js, Environment Variables row API_KEY = ••••••, Deploy button (.btn.go)

slides.label: Error 1
slides.idea: Your app still calls localhost: change the fetch URL to your live backend link.
slides.title: Here's the quick fix when data won't load.
slides.line: Replace localhost with your live backend link.
slides.screen: Browser console with a red error 'Failed to fetch http://localhost:5000/api/routes', below it a two-line code diff replacing localhost:5000 with campus-bus-api.onrender.com

slides.label: Error 2
slides.idea: Your API key is undefined: add it on the host, then redeploy.
slides.title: This won't work unless the host has your keys.
slides.line: Add them under Environment Variables, then redeploy.
slides.screen: Build/runtime log cropped: 'Error: API_KEY is undefined' highlighted, a 'Redeploy' button beside it

slides.idea: Cheat sheet: 3 hosts by project type; 4 clicks (push without .env, import, add keys, Deploy); 3 errors + fixes incl. Error 3: free Render app sleeps after 15 idle minutes, first load takes about a minute (normal).
